title: AgentSwap: swaps for AI agents on Solana
description: Token swaps for AI agents on Solana. Pay $0.01 per call with x402, get an unsigned Jupiter-routed transaction, sign it yourself.

sections.heading: YOUR AGENT HAS USDC. THE SITE WANTS BONK.
sections.text: SWAP API FOR AI AGENTS · SOLANA MAINNET · X402 YOUR AGENT HAS USDC. THE SITE WANTS BONK. One HTTP call swaps the token your agent holds for the token a service wants. It pays $0.01 through x402 and gets back an unsigned Jupiter-routed transaction, which it signs with its own key. READ THE API → ADD TO CLAUDE LIVE QUOTE MAINNET 1 USDC → 0.008048228 SOL route: Byreal · slippage 50 bps

sections.heading: AGENTS CAN PAY. JUST NOT IN THE RIGHT TOKEN.
sections.text: 01 · THE PROBLEM AGENTS CAN PAY. JUST NOT IN THE RIGHT TOKEN. A x402 lets an agent pay for an HTTP call, but on Solana that means USDC. B Services price in SOL, stables, memecoins and their own tokens. C Swapping today means a DEX UI and a wallet popup. An agent can't click through that. 02 · THE FIX A SWAP THAT SPEAKS HTTP. A The price comes as a machine-readable 402, so the agent's x402 client pays it automatically. B Jupiter finds the best route across Solana DEXs. C We return an unsigned transaction. The agent signs it and sends it itself.

sections.heading: ONE SWAP, FOUR MESSAGES.
sections.text: ONE SWAP, FOUR MESSAGES. 03 · FLOW AGENT ⇄ AGENTSWAP ⇄ JUPITER ⇄ SOLANA # REQUEST RESPONSE COST 1 GET /api/quote?from=USDC&to=SOL&amount=1 200 · amount out + route free 2 POST /api/swap 402 · PAYMENT-REQUIRED: exact · 10000 (= $0.01 USDC) · fee sponsored price tag, not paid yet 3 POST /api/swap + x402 payment 200 · swapTransaction (base64, unsigned) · lastValidBlockHeight $0.01 USDC 4 sign locally → sendTransaction tokens land in the agent's wallet · verifiable on Solscan network fee (SOL)

sections.heading: FOUR WAYS IN.
sections.text: FOUR WAYS IN. 05 · INTERFACES HTTP API For agents that write their own code. GET /api/tokens GET /api/quote POST /api/swap MCP For Claude and any other MCP client. No integration code needed. list_tokens get_quote swap_info SKILL.MD A drop-in skill: when to swap, the flow, and a working TS example. /skill.md ↗ LLMS.TXT So a crawling agent finds the API on its own. /llms.txt ↗ claude mcp add --transport http agentswap http://localhost:8787/mcp COPY

sections.heading: NON-CUSTODIAL BY DESIGN.
sections.text: 07 · TRUST MODEL NON-CUSTODIAL BY DESIGN. AgentSwap builds transactions and never signs them. If our server disappeared tomorrow, no agent would lose a cent. KEYS Never sent to us. The response is an unsigned VersionedTransaction. SLIPPAGE Bounded at 1–1000 bps, 50 by default, and enforced on-chain by the route. PAYMENT The x402 fee is settled only when the swap build succeeds. A failed request is never charged. STATE None. A stateless Cloudflare Worker with no database and no accounts.
